          title: Address

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255

          title: Address line 1

          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'

## Summary

I implemented the `selfLink` field so `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns `selfLink = "/api/owners/" + id`.

Two changes, kept deliberately minimal to hold structural impact low:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a `selfLink` (read-only string) property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added one `@Mapping` line to the `toOwnerDto` method:
   ```java
   @Mapping(target = "selfLink", expression = "java(owner.getId() == null ? null : \"/api/owners/\" + owner.getId())")
   ```

### Why this design
The link is purely derivable from the owner's id, so I computed it as a MapStruct mapping expression alongside the existing derived fields (`displayName`, `membershipNumber`, etc.) rather than adding logic to a controller. That deliberately avoids editing `OwnerRestControllerV1.getOwner`, which lives in a large class with high `WMC_other` — every line changed there would have been multiplied by the whole controller's summed complexity. The `OwnerMapper` is a small, cohesive interface (low `WMC_other`), the changed method is a branch-free abstract declaration (`CC = 1`), and the change is a single added line. The result is one small edit in a low-complexity unit, with the second touched file being pure YAML schema (no function complexity).

All tests pass.
